author: Rosa Menkman from Amsterdam, Netherlands
description: Around 500 AC, st. Columba, a monk who exiled himself from Ireland because of his "war of the book" - a war between him and the Irish king about a book he copied secretly - used Fingal's Cave on Staffa to contemplate "the eternal, hexagonally jointed basalt columns, sprouting from the graves of ancient, enlightened Celtic monks."
